scope: Members directory, human profiles, and Agent profiles across desktop and both locked mobile viewports, including reliability, capability, status, dialog, and deterministic-return states

viewports.primaryNavigation: present on Members root and absent on both profile details
present on Members root and absent on both profile details

interactionEvidence.directoryHistory: typing qa human wrote memberQ=qa+human to the URL, reduced the directory to QA Human 309, and a real refresh restored both query and result
interactionEvidence.directoryReliability: a browser-only forced 503 on /api/agents produced a retryable alert with zero member cards; retry cleared the alert and restored three real members
interactionEvidence.directoryFilters: native-search plus keyboard-operable type, Agent-status, and human-role selectors compose through one pure filtering contract; working activity overrides an inactive lifecycle and failure remains separately filterable
interactionEvidence.profileReliability: Agent and human responses reject error or malformed envelopes, exit loading into an alert, discard stale async requests, and expose retry
interactionEvidence.realtimeStatus: Agent profile and sidebar use the same activity-first status function; Socket.IO agent events update the open profile in place, while machine-offline reconciliation converts active and sleeping Agents to inactive/offline
interactionEvidence.actions: lifecycle, reset, delete, avatar, human profile, role, removal, and invite operations check server error bodies; busy controls disable repeated submission and rejection never navigates or closes as success
interactionEvidence.dialogs: Create Agent and Invite Member were opened in the real browser; focus entered each named aria-modal dialog, Escape closed it, and focus returned to the exact sidebar trigger
interactionEvidence.mobileReturn: 375px Agent and human details exposed a 44x44 Back target, hid primary navigation, and returned deterministically to Members where primary navigation reappeared
interactionEvidence.touchAndOverflow: all mobile profile tabs and visible profile actions measured 44px high; all three pages measured zero horizontal page overflow at 390px and 375px

permissionEvidence.directory: read-only members receive truthful directory content plus an explicit limited-permission notice; create and invite triggers remain absent without manageAgents/manageMembers
permissionEvidence.agent: profile editing, personality, skills, lifecycle, restart, and delete operations render only with manageAgents; the server remains authoritative for every attempted mutation
permissionEvidence.human: self-edit is limited to the authenticated identity; role and removal controls render only with changeMemberRoles/manageMembers and still branch on server rejection
permissionEvidence.invite: the trigger requires manageMembers, the endpoint independently requires manageMembers, and a rejected GET or POST remains a retryable dialog error

intentionalDifferences: Raft Members root shows only its sidebar plus an empty selection prompt; ticket #312 requires a searchable and filterable directory, so OpenTag keeps its real directory in the main pane instead of copying that functional gap.
OpenTag keeps its existing runtime, permission, personality, skill, workspace, reminder, integration, and activity contracts instead of inventing Raft-only role, environment, app, or MCP data.
OpenTag uses its licensed design tokens and real local identities/statuses rather than Raft private fonts, avatars, labels, or workspace data.
Classic remains unchanged as the immediate rollback surface.
